environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) behind API Gateway REST API. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with row-level security policies on users and notification_templates tables (USING clause: tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid). The DB_USER is 'app_service' which is a non-superuser role with FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY applied via ALTER TABLE ... FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, ensuring RLS applies even to table owners. The role has SELECT-only grants on users and notification_templates. Additionally, pg_catalog and information_schema access is revoked from app_service role (REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA pg_catalog FROM app_service). The Lambda function's IAM execution role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/TenantIsolationBoundary) that restricts secrets access to only the app_service credentials path.

config.api_gateway: REST API, usage plan with 100 req/s throttle
